jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
#### **Stap als** **Senior Software Engineer** **in een wereld waar digitalisering nooit stilstaat. Waar financiële processen slimmer, sneller en efficiënter worden en waar jij met jouw technische expertise het verschil maakt voor banken, verzekeraars en andere grote spelers in de financiële sector.**

**Wat ga je doen?**
-------------------

Als Senior Software Engineer bouw je aan de slimme digitale klantreizen van morgen. Je werkt aan complexe softwareplatforms, denkt mee over technische keuzes en zorgt ervoor dat oplossingen niet alleen vandaag werken, maar ook klaar zijn voor de toekomst.

Je hebt binnen het team een belangrijke technische rol. Je overziet complexe vraagstukken, bewaakt de kwaliteit van onze software en helpt collega’s verder in hun ontwikkeling. Daarbij werk je nauw samen met onder andere Software Engineers, Product Owners en andere disciplines.

* Ontwerp, ontwikkel en onderhoud softwareplatforms die aansluiten op de systemen en processen van onze klanten binnen hypotheken, verzekeringen en pensioenen.
* Vertaal complexe functionele vraagstukken naar schaalbare en onderhoudbare technische oplossingen.
* Maak technische keuzes en denk mee over architectuur, kwaliteit, performance en security.
* Werk met moderne technologieën zoals Kubernetes, microservices, distributed systems en Azure.
* Begeleid junior en medior Software Engineers en help hen groeien door kennis te delen, feedback te geven en samen technische vraagstukken op te lossen.
* Schat de complexiteit en impact van technische werkzaamheden in en help het team bij het maken van realistische keuzes en planningen.
* Werk samen met de Product Owner aan het bepalen en bewaken van functionele en niet-functionele eisen.
* Stem waar nodig af met andere teams, klanten en externe partijen.
* Volg nieuwe technologische ontwikkelingen en vertaal relevante ontwikkelingen naar verbeteringen binnen onze software en manier van werken.

Kortom: jij bouwt niet alleen mee aan slimme digitale klantreizen, maar helpt ook de technische kwaliteit en ontwikkeling van het team naar een hoger niveau te brengen.

**Wat hebben wij jou te bieden?**
---------------------------------

Bij TJIP krijg je de ruimte om jouw expertise in te zetten, technische keuzes te beïnvloeden en impact te maken binnen een mensgerichte organisatie waar plezier en professionaliteit samenkomen.

**Je kunt rekenen op:**

* Een goed salaris, passend bij jouw kennis en ervaring.
* Hybride werken, inclusief thuiswerkvergoeding.
* Veel ruimte voor eigen inbreng, initiatief en zelfstandigheid.
* Ruime opleidings- en ontwikkelmogelijkheden met certificeringen en inspirerende sessies.
* Een goede pensioenregeling en mogelijkheid tot deelname aan onze collectieve zorgverzekering.
* Laptop van de zaak.
* Een fijne werkplek in Delft, midden in het innovatiegebied van de TU.
* Dagelijkse gezamenlijke lunch.

**Wat breng jij mee?**
----------------------

* Hbo- of wo-werk- en denkniveau, bij voorkeur in informatica, software engineering of een vergelijkbare richting.
* Ruime ervaring als Software Engineer en het vermogen om zelfstandig complexe technische vraagstukken op te pakken.
* Ruime kennis van en ervaring met .NET en/of JavaScript/TypeScript.
* Ervaring met het ontwerpen en bouwen van schaalbare en onderhoudbare softwareoplossingen.
* Ervaring met Agile- en Scrum-methodieken.
* Kennis van moderne softwareontwikkelprincipes en technieken zoals Domain Driven Design, Test Driven Development, Continuous Delivery/Deployment, microservices en containerization met Docker en Kubernetes.
* Het vermogen om technische keuzes helder uit te leggen en andere Software Engineers daarin mee te nemen.
* Je vindt het leuk om kennis te delen en junior en medior collega's te begeleiden in hun ontwikkeling.
* Goede communicatieve vaardigheden en een goede beheersing van de Nederlandse taal.
* Een zelfstandige, nieuwsgierige en proactieve instelling. Je kijkt verder dan je eigen code en ziet waar techniek, samenwerking of processen beter kunnen.

**TJIP’er worden?**
-------------------

* Solliciteer direct of neem contact op met Linda van der Meer en Ellis Slot via **recruitment@tjip.com** of via WhatsApp op **015 789 0732**.
* Binnen zeven dagen nemen we contact met je op. Bij enthousiasme plannen we twee gesprekken in: een kennismakingsgesprek en een technisch inhoudelijk gesprek.
* We doen je een aanbod waar we allemaal blij van worden en kijken ernaar uit jou te ontvangen als nieuwe TJIP’er.

**Over TJIP**
-------------

Sinds 1999 helpen wij organisaties die hun klanten financieel inzicht en vertrouwen willen bieden, zodat iedereen grip krijgt op zijn of haar financiële keuzes. Met slimme softwareoplossingen faciliteren wij het proces rondom financiële producten zoals hypotheken, verzekeringen, pensioenen en beleggingsproducten.

We zijn een ambitieuze organisatie die gelijke kansen biedt. We vieren diversiteit en zetten ons in voor een inclusieve omgeving voor alle collega’s. Als je gedreven bent en zin hebt om met ons mee te groeien, ben je hier op je plek. Want alles wat we doen, doen we graag samen én net even iets slimmer.

*Acquisitie naar aanleiding van deze vacature wordt niet op prijs gesteld.*

jobs.title: Senior Advanced Project Engineer
jobs.description:
We have an exciting opportunity for an experienced, and motivated individual to join our site in Yeovil as a Sr Advanced Project Engineer. You will be part of a team assessing and driving achievement of program specific performance within Honeywell Aerospace. You will be working on complex aerospace engineering projects across a variety of remits including Environmental Control Systems (ECS), Hydraulics, and Life Support Systems (LSS).

Join a company that's reintroducing itself to the aviation community we've helped advance for more than a century. At Honeywell Aerospace (NASDAQ: HONA), we're launching as an independent, publicly traded aerospace and defense company built on a legacy of operational excellence and mission-focused execution.

Our new brand identity pairs that heritage with real momentum, as we build technology that helps pilots navigate with confidence, aircraft operate more efficiently, and operators stay ahead of change. With our systems on board 90% of the world's aircraft, your work here has reach that's rare to find anywhere else.

Focusing on our customers, investing in innovation, and building a culture of accountability and performance is how we're shaping what comes next.
  
Every horizon. Every mission. Every day.

Honeywell Aerospace products and services are found on aircraft across commercial aviation, defense and space — from engines and cockpit electronics to cabin systems, mechanical components and connectivity solutions. Our technology helps operators fly more safely, reduce fuel consumption, improve on-time performance and deliver a better experience for the people on board.

As aviation continues to evolve, we're also developing systems to support autonomous and supersonic platforms, bringing the same focus on safety and efficiency to the next era of flight. With approximately 36,000 employees worldwide and net sales of $17.4B in 2025, Honeywell Aerospace is one of the largest dedicated aerospace companies in the world. Explore our businesses: https://www.honeywellaerospace.com

Control Systems develops the thermal and motion control systems that help aircraft take off, land safely and protect the people on board. With more than 10 million passengers per day flying on aircraft equipped with our products and more than 75% of commercial flights beginning with our engine start systems, Control Systems reaches farther across the aviation industry than most people realize.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Create project plans, schedules, and determine milestones to customer expectations using earned value metrics
* Monitor and maintain project plans, ensure focus is maintained to milestone adherence to ensure products are delivered on time
* Create and monitor the progress of work packages for internal suppliers to support technical and schedule adherence.
* Build internal and external customer relationships throughout projects to ensure completion
* Ensuring that projects run within cost, quality, and time metrics
* Management of requirements, including requirements validation and the appropriate allocation of requirements
* Co-ordinate and Lead Design Reviews in accordance with HAY procedures
* Manage project risks and mitigation plans.

  **Key requirements and skills**
* HND/HNC/Degree in mechanical engineering/aerospace
* Excellent communication skills, verbal and written
* A minimum of three years’ project management experience in an engineering, aerospace, safety-critical, or similarly regulated environment, with demonstrable delivery experience across the full product lifecycle from conception to commissioning
* Previous experience of using Microsoft Project, or a similar project forecasting system
* A strong understanding and experience of working with suppliers and integrated supply chains and how and where they fit in the project lifecycle

  **Our Offer**
* Opportunity to work on cutting-edge technologies with global impact.
* A collaborative and innovative environment within a world-leading technology company.
* Professional development and career growth opportunities.

  **Join us now and make an impact!**

  #LI-Hybrid

jobs.title: AI Developer & Automation Apprentice
jobs.description:
**Are you excited by AI and curious about how technology can transform the way businesses work?**

**We’re looking for an AI Developer & Automation Apprentice to join our AI implementation programme and help shape the future of AI across the firm.**

This is a unique opportunity to gain hands-on experience in AI development, automation, business analysis, process improvement and change management while working on real projects that deliver meaningful business impact.

You'll work alongside experienced developers, technical specialists and business stakeholders to identify opportunities where AI and automation can improve the way we work. You’ll then help design, build, test and implement solutions, as well as supporting colleagues to adopt and get the most from new technology.

Rawlinson & Hunter is a leading international firm of Chartered Accountants, providing specialist accounting, taxation and advisory services to high-net-worth individuals, families and businesses. Technology has been an important part of the firm's development for more than 20 years, and we have an established in-house IT team comprising developers, cloud specialists, support professionals and trainers.

**What you’ll be doing:**

You'll be involved throughout the lifecycle of AI and automation projects, working with both technical and non-technical stakeholders across the firm.

Your responsibilities will include:

* Supporting requirements gathering, process mapping and identifying opportunities for AI and automation.
* Assisting with the design and development of AI applications, agents, workflows and automation solutions.
* Building and refining solutions using AI development tools, coding assistants and automation platforms.
* Testing AI solutions to ensure they are accurate, reliable, secure and fit for purpose.
* Supporting the deployment, documentation and rollout of new AI-powered solutions.
* Creating user guides and training materials and supporting colleagues with the adoption of new technology.
* Gathering user feedback and helping identify opportunities for improvement.

**What we’re looking for:**

We're looking for someone curious about technology, who enjoys solving problems and is excited by the potential of AI.

You may have developed your experience through education, personal projects, online learning, previous employment or simply experimenting with technology in your own time.

We're looking for candidates who:

* Have a strong interest in AI, software development and emerging technologies.
* Have some programming experience or willingness to develop programming skills with languages such as Python, JavaScript, C#, TypeScript or SQL.
* Enjoy analysing problems and finding ways to improve processes.
* Have excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Can work confidently with both technical and non-technical colleagues.
* Are organised, reliable and detail-oriented.
* Are eager to learn and develop new technical skills.
* Can work effectively both independently and as part of a team.

Experience with AI tools, coding assistants, workflow automation, APIs, Agile, Jira or the Microsoft technology stack would be beneficial, but **is not essential**.

**Entry requirements:**

* Level 3 Qualification (Apprenticeship/A Levels/BTEC etc.)
* OR equivalent work experience (typically 2 years in a relevant role)  
  **AND**
* 5 x GCSE’s including English & Maths at Grade 4 (C) or above.

**Working hours:** 37.5 hours per week (Monday to Friday, 9am - 5pm with 30 minutes lunch break)

**What we offer:**

* 25 days annual leave plus bank holidays.
* Discretionary annual bonus review.
* Internal coaching, professional development and training opportunities.
* Company pension scheme.
* Private medical insurance.
* Free on-site gym (Leatherhead office).
* Discounted gym memberships.
* Cycle to Work scheme.
* Team social events (e.g. Christmas and summer parties).

**Future prospects:**

90% of QA apprentices secure permanent employment after completing: this is 20% higher than the national average.

**About QA:**

Our apprenticeships are the perfect way to gain new skills, earn while you learn, and launch yourself into an exciting future. With over 50,000 successful apprenticeship graduates, we're a top 50 training provider, dedicated to helping you succeed.

**Interested? Apply now!**
